content: ...m funds practices, contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, and help shape how we grow this function globally. - Confidently helping asset management teams navigate one of the biggest shifts in how the industry operates - from evaluating the ROI and competitive advantage of AI to clearly mapping how AI will impact different functions, from fund formation and side letter negotiation to regulatory compliance and investor reporting. - Understanding and navigating the requirements of regulated financial institutions, including confidentiality expectations, information barriers, vendor due diligence, and the scrutiny that comes with SEC oversight. - Partnering with deal teams at sponsors, sovereign investors, and law firms on transaction workflows - building diligence grids, closing checklists, and document review processes that run at deal speed across M&A, growth, and venture transactions. WHAT YOU BRING You come from the world of funds, asset management, or M&A; but you've never been content with how things have always been done. You may have practiced as a private funds associate at a leading law firm, negotiating fund documents, side letters, and co-investment structures. Perhaps you've worked in-house at an asset manager, running lean legal processes across the full fund lifecycle. Maybe you've built your career in compliance, managing regulatory obligations, exams, and investor requirements at an investment firm. Or you may have cut your teeth in M&A or ECVC, running diligence and negotiating transaction documents under deal pressure. Either way, you know how asset management and funds teams — in-house and at law firms — think, work, and (sometimes) struggle and you're ready to help them level up with technology. You'll thrive in this role if you: - Hold a law degree (JD or equivalent) and bring 3+ years of experience in a private funds or M&A/ECVC practice at a law firm, in-house at an asset management firm, or in a regulatory or compliance function - ideally with exposure to multiple fund strategies, structures, deal types, or jurisdictions. - Understand the asset management context: fund lifecycles, GP/LP dynamics, side letter and MFN obligation

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. This role operates across functions and geographies, owning programs end-to-end while building the structure, processes, and tools that let the Workplace team operate consistently and at scale without slowing down. This is a cross-functional role that requires strong program management fundamentals, independent judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. What matters is that you have driven change in a professional services setting: persuading experienced, sceptical, time-poor people to work differently, and making it stick. That might have been inside a law firm, in innovation, change, transformation or business development. It might have been consulting into firms, or at a vendor working alongside them. Having practised law is welcome but is not required. Beyond that: - Three to five years in either: - Customer Success or Account Management in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. - Innovation, Change, Transformation or a related role in a law firm or comparable professional services organisation. - A track record of driving retention and satisfaction in the enterprise space. - Evidence you have changed behaviour, not just managed a relationship. - Highly organised. These clients are large and complex, which means competing priorities and requests to keep track of. - Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication. You can hold a room of partners, then sit down with a trainee and work through their prompt with them. - High EQ and commercial instinct. You know when to listen, when to advise, and when to act. - A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where priorities can shift rapidly and you adapt with them. - Comfortable with metrics. Driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process. Importantly, you are someone who enjoys being in the office five days a week, with onsite client time in the UK and abroad.
